title: Delivery run
description: The one record of a project's Delivery (R9): which handoff it runs from, the setup a human gave it, one state per stage written only by the thing that changed it, and the append-only flags of every decision taken outside the arithmetic. No model writes a byte of this — every field is the runner's, so the output contract derived from it is empty.

id.description: The project's slug. One run per project: a new handoff is adopted and moves the approved stages stale; it never starts a second run.

handoff.description: The snapshot this run reads — the only Discovery artifact Delivery ever reads (R14), pinned by content hash so a moved handoff is detected, never assumed.

path.description: Root-relative path of the handoff file.

cap.description: Judged rounds a stage gets before a block is the human's call (R6). Starts at 2 (§10.5).

ceiling.description: The most rounds an escalation can buy up to (R6). Starts at 3. Never below the cap.

liveness_ms.description: A running stage silent longer than this reads as dead (R9). Starts at five minutes.

budget.description: USD the run may spend, checked against the ledger before every call (R1). Null is uncapped — the subscription is the cap.

models.description: Per-role model overrides for this run, keyed `delivery.<role>`; a role the config does not know is refused at setup.

stages.description: One state per stage, in pipeline order. The status enum is the state machine's vocabulary — `dead` is not in it: dead is read from the heartbeat by the one reader, never written.

flags.description: Append-only: every door a human took with its reason, every override named as one with the guard it passed, every restart over a dead stage, every handoff adopted. Nothing here is ever removed or rewritten.

round.description: Judged rounds in the current episode. A finish counts one; a pin refresh never does (R5); a stop, a reopen or a moved handoff opens a new episode at zero.

heartbeat_at.description: Written by the wrapper while it runs. Its age against liveness_ms is the only thing that says dead.

verdict.description: Root-relative path of the verdict the last round filed — a finding document pinned to what it judged. Read back by the approve door; presence is never evidence, the pins are.

reopened.description: Present only while a reopen is being answered: the human's name and reason, set by the reopen and cleared by the finish that files the redo's verdict. The writer of that round reads it; a restart over a stop or a death still knows why the stage runs.

override.description: True when a human's word passed a guard that would otherwise have refused.

guard.description: The guard overridden, by its refusal code — judge-blocked, verdict-stale.

note.description: What the runner has to say about it: the finding overridden, the silence that read as dead.
